first_line: The paper's numbers partly hold up: 1 of 1 checked results match within their uncertainty. Its main result, interior_curvature_max_n, is 23 countries in the paper and 39 countries here (not judged: a tally of what the analysis found, with no uncertainty).

headline.name: interior_curvature_max_n
headline.why: a tally of what the analysis found, with no uncertainty, so it is not judged

rejections.reason: the script writes the paper's sample count as a result's count, or cuts its sample to it (income_vis_sample_n (12) at line 142). Build the sample from the paper's definition and report the count you get; never trim, cut or pad it to a reported count.
